verdict.rationale: Guidance pages on corp.delaware.gov (howtoform, paytaxes, frtax, fee) were captured verbatim as static text, and probes on that host returned plain HTTP 404s rather than a challenge page, so the public reading surface appears reachable without a bot wall or JS-only shell. However, no probe explicitly records a keyless fetch with an identified user agent succeeding. The adjacent icis.corp.delaware.gov entry page, which also carries reading text, sits behind an image CAPTCHA. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 for guidance pages under a standard identified UA, confirmation that no challenge or interstitial appears on any reading page, and a CAPTCHA-free icis host.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
